newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-AEK ATHENS V PARIS ST GERMAIN TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AEK ATHENS V PARIS ST GERMAIN TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg match between Greece's AEK Athens and France's Paris St Germain.

AEK: 1-Ilias Atmatsidis, 25-Vassilis Borbokis, 21-Michalis Kasapis, 12-Stelios Manolas, 6-Michalis Vlachos, 2-Triantafilos Maheridis, 7-Timour Ketspagia, 8-Toni Savevski, 9-Daniel Batista, 10-Christos Costis, 11-Demis Nikolaidis.
PSG: 1-Bernard Lama, 13-Laurent Fournier, 4-Bruno N'Gotty, 6-Paul le Guen, 2-Daniel Kenedy, 8-Vincent Guerin, 15-Benoit Cauet, 10-Rai, 7-Leonardo, 11-Patrice Loko, 19-Jerome Leroy.
